title: LJCP Judicial Statistics of Pakistan
publisher: Law and Justice Commission of Pakistan
primary_geography: reported sessions division or district judicial unit

annual_gaps.2019: No annual edition located in the inspected current and archived publication catalogues.
annual_gaps.2023_balochistan: Provincial all/civil/criminal aggregates are available; district chapter has selected category tables but no consolidated district all/civil/criminal flows.
annual_gaps.2025: Annual edition not located; January-June provincial statistics are retained separately.
annual_gaps.2021_categories_and_staffing: Scanned edition: only the all/civil/criminal case tables were transcribed; no category tables or staffing.
annual_gaps.2015_2016_2018_2019: Never listed on LJCP or in any Wayback capture (checked 2026-09-06); treated as unpublished.
annual_gaps.2017: Exists (Wayback 2021-04-25 capture under the reused 2014 filename); catalogued, not yet retrieved or specified.
annual_gaps.2024_kp_staffing: Neither 2024 edition prints KP district staffing.

crosswalk_caveat: Name matches are provisional. Group complete Chitral, Kohistan and ICT subdivisions before joining population. Balochistan town seats are keyed to their containing map district and two-seat districts are summed. Districts without a court seat in a year (Korangi, Keamari, Sujawal pre-2023, Sherani, Sohbatpur, Washuk pre-2022, Harnai 2020) enter the host division's population denominator and receive no observation; see hosted_districts.
refresh_policy: Manual reproducible run; source editions are checksum-pinned. New years and replacement editions require table and geography review. No scheduled scraping is configured.
population_bases: geometric_2017_2023_interpolated_year_end (fallback to fixed 2023 where implied growth is outside 0-6%/yr)
